top_catalysts.event: September manufacturing remains expansionary while input-cost pressure rises
top_catalysts.status: 已发生；按历史截止线重建
top_catalysts.what_happened: ISM manufacturing was 54.5 in September; the prices index rose to 77.9 from 71.1 and new orders reached 55.3. These are diffusion measures, not inflation rates.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The headline softened slightly from 54.6 while costs rose, so a stable activity reading conceals a less favorable cost mix.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Retrospective conditional analysis: Persistent input costs can squeeze margins unless passed through; pass-through may keep policy restrictive even when the headline PMI does not accelerate.
top_catalysts.transmission: 成本扩散→利润率/通胀风险→利率与估值。 UST2Y is the first observable transmission channel, not a guaranteed price direction.
top_catalysts.direction: 双向，取决于后续数据与市场确认
top_catalysts.confirmation: Subsequent inflation releases and company gross-margin guidance corroborate cost persistence.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Input prices retreat and firms maintain margins without price increases, weakening the cost-pressure channel.

top_catalysts.event: China fuel-export restrictions and Middle East reports lift oil
top_catalysts.status: 已发生；按历史截止线重建
top_catalysts.what_happened: Reuters reported Chinese refiners suspending October oil-product exports and cited reporting on additional US military deployment. December Brent settled at $102.31 on October 1.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The retained settlement shows higher oil prices alongside new supply-risk reports; it does not establish the actual production loss from military developments.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Retrospective conditional analysis: Product export limits can intensify diesel scarcity even when crude supply exists; transport costs may reach consumer inflation and industrial margins.
top_catalysts.transmission: 燃料供应→运输与生产成本→通胀/利润率。 Brent December 2026 is the first observable transmission channel, not a guaranteed price direction.
top_catalysts.direction: 双向，取决于后续数据与市场确认
top_catalysts.confirmation: Official export, refinery or inventory data confirm a sustained loss of available refined products.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Export resumption or actual reserve releases ease product scarcity and reduce the supply-premium interpretation.

top_catalysts.event: September employment report is still ahead of the historical cutoff
top_catalysts.what_happened: BLS had scheduled the September employment report for October 2 at 08:30EDT, two-and-a-half hours after this 18:00SGT cutoff. No actual result belongs in this edition.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The information set is moving toward a scheduled labor test; it has not yet changed through a released September payroll figure.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Retrospective conditional analysis: Payrolls, wages and participation can pull policy expectations in different directions; judging the headline alone risks confusing labor supply with demand.
top_catalysts.transmission: 就业和工资→政策预期→债券/美元/股市。 UST2Y is the first observable transmission channel, not a guaranteed price direction.
top_catalysts.direction: 双向，取决于后续数据与市场确认
top_catalysts.confirmation: The release is published and payrolls, wages and participation provide a consistent labor-demand signal.
top_catalysts.invalidation: A weak headline is explained by supply or revisions while wages remain firm, invalidating a simple demand-slowdown interpretation.
